records.title: DELNet: Continuous All-in-One Weather Removal via Dynamic Expert Library
records.reason: DELNet stores and reuses experts for continual image-weather restoration and reports PSNR improvements across restoration datasets. Its expert routing is a vision-restoration task, with no language-model serving or inference-cost result.

records.title: Model-Free Neural Filtering: A Comparison with Classical Filters in Nonlinear Systems
records.reason: The paper compares Transformer, RNN and SSM neural estimators against classical filters for nonlinear state estimation. It is a control/filtering evaluation and does not propose or benchmark LLM inference systems.

records.title: LMK > CLS: Landmark Pooling for Dense Embeddings
records.reason: LMK pooling divides token sequences into chunks with learned landmark tokens and reports improved dense-embedding/long-context behavior at modest added computation. This is a representation/pooling method rather than a model-serving optimization; the relevance to long-context LLM inference is possible but not demonstrated as reduced memory or latency.

records.title: Learning from Self-Debate: Preparing Reasoning Models for Multi-Agent Debate
records.reason: Self-Debate RL trains a single reasoning model to use multiple sampled rationales in later debate rounds and evaluates reasoning/debate quality. It requires multi-sample/debate context at test time and does not establish lower inference compute or serving cost; it is an adjacent test-time reasoning line.

records.title: LCM-Net: LLM-Driven Cross-Modality MoE Feature Fusion Network for Cancer Survival Analysis
records.reason: IEEE DOI https://doi.org/10.1109/TMI.2026.3657518 was inaccessible. Abstract describes LLM-driven MoE feature fusion for cancer survival analysis; primary methods/evaluation and the linked MoE-relevance could not be verified.
